name: Snowshed pullout on Donner Pass Road in front of the wall (blue outhouse)
basis: Snowshed Wall MP Getting There: after the small bridge the road bends right, a few pullouts later a blue outhouse on the right marks the Snowshed pullout; 2-min walk across the stream to the north face. SummitPost: turnout on the south side of the road directly in front of Snowshed Wall, 4-6 cars, just below the Donner Summit Bridge. Brief lot w1204950654 sits on Donner Pass Road (roads.mjs: 0.01 km from the segment 39.3189,-120.3190 -> 39.3223,-120.3143), about 130 m from the wall; alternative w275952699 is also on the road but 330 m away, so the nearer pullout was chosen. Match by position.
